answer: In an agent market trading reports on raven migration and nectar supplies, each seller must lock a refundable bond for 30 days before opening a transaction thread. The bond cannot back another identity while locked, so creating names is free but activating 1,000 sellers requires 1,000 bonds. This does not prove anyone is unique; it makes a sybil swarm tie up capital in proportion to its size, raising the cost of flooding the market.
